   616→        self: &Arc<Self>,
   617→        message_id: MessageId,
   618→        peer_id: PeerId,
   619→        subnet_id: DataColumnSubnetId,
   620→        column_sidecar: Arc<DataColumnSidecar<T::EthSpec>>,
   621→        seen_duration: Duration,
   622→    ) {

   624→        let block_root = column_sidecar.block_root();
   625→        let index = column_sidecar.index;
   626→        let delay = get_slot_delay_ms(seen_duration, slot, &self.chain.slot_clock);
   627→        // Log metrics to track delay from other nodes on the network.
   628→        metrics::observe_duration(
   629→            &metrics::BEACON_DATA_COLUMN_GOSSIP_SLOT_START_DELAY_TIME,
   630→            delay,
   631→        );
   632→        match self
   633→            .chain
   634→            .verify_data_column_sidecar_for_gossip(column_sidecar.clone(), subnet_id)
   635→        {
   636→            Ok(gossip_verified_data_column) => {
   637→                metrics::inc_counter(
   638→                    &metrics::BEACON_PROCESSOR_GOSSIP_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_VERIFIED_TOTAL,
   639→                );
   640→
   641→                debug!(
   642→                    %slot,
   643→                    %block_root,
   644→                    %index,
   645→                    "Successfully verified gossip data column sidecar"
   646→                );
   647→
   648→                self.propagate_validation_result(message_id, peer_id, MessageAcceptance::Accept);
   649→
   650→                // Log metrics to keep track of propagation delay times.
   651→                if let Some(duration) = SystemTime::now()
   652→                    .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
   653→                    .ok()
   654→                    .and_then(|now| now.checked_sub(seen_duration))
   655→                {
   656→                    metrics::observe_duration(
   657→                        &metrics::BEACON_DATA_COLUMN_GOSSIP_PROPAGATION_VERIFICATION_DELAY_TIME,
   658→                        duration,
   659→                    );
   660→                }
   661→
   662→                self.process_gossip_verified_data_column(
   663→                    peer_id,
   664→                    gossip_verified_data_column,
   665→                    seen_duration,
   666→                )
   667→                .await
   668→            }
   669→            Err(err) => {
   670→                match err {
   671→                    GossipDataColumnError::PriorKnownUnpublished => {
   672→                        debug!(
   673→                            %slot,
   674→                            %block_root,
   675→                            %index,
   676→                            "Gossip data column already processed via the EL. Accepting the column sidecar without re-processing."
   677→                        );
   678→                        self.propagate_validation_result(
   679→                            message_id,
   680→                            peer_id,
   681→                            MessageAcceptance::Accept,
   682→                        );
   683→                    }
   684→                    GossipDataColumnError::ParentUnknown { parent_root } => {
   685→                        debug!(
   686→                            action = "requesting parent",
   687→                            %block_root,
   688→                            %parent_root,
   689→                            "Unknown parent hash for column"
   690→                        );
   691→                        self.send_sync_message(SyncMessage::UnknownParentDataColumn(
   692→                            peer_id,
   693→                            column_sidecar,
   694→                        ));
   695→                    }
   696→                    GossipDataColumnError::PubkeyCacheTimeout
   697→                    | GossipDataColumnError::BeaconChainError(_) => {
   698→                        crit!(
   699→                            error = ?err,
   700→                            "Internal error when verifying column sidecar"
   701→                        )
   702→                    }
   703→                    GossipDataColumnError::ProposalSignatureInvalid
   704→                    | GossipDataColumnError::UnknownValidator(_)
   705→                    | GossipDataColumnError::ProposerIndexMismatch { .. }
   706→                    | GossipDataColumnError::IsNotLaterThanParent { .. }
   707→                    | GossipDataColumnError::InvalidSubnetId { .. }
   708→                    | GossipDataColumnError::InvalidInclusionProof
   709→                    | GossipDataColumnError::InvalidKzgProof { .. }
   710→                    | GossipDataColumnError::UnexpectedDataColumn
   711→                    | GossipDataColumnError::InvalidColumnIndex(_)
   712→                    | GossipDataColumnError::InconsistentCommitmentsLength { .. }
   713→                    | GossipDataColumnError::InconsistentProofsLength { .. }
   714→                    | GossipDataColumnError::NotFinalizedDescendant { .. } => {
   715→                        debug!(
   716→                            error = ?err,
   717→                            %slot,
   718→                            %block_root,
   719→                            %index,
   720→                            "Could not verify column sidecar for gossip. Rejecting the column sidecar"
   721→                        );

   732→                        );
   733→                    }

   743→                        )
   744→                    }
   745→                    GossipDataColumnError::FutureSlot { .. }

   753→                        );

   758→                            "gossip_data_column_high",
   759→                        );
   760→                        self.propagate_validation_result(
   761→                            message_id,
   762→                            peer_id,
   763→                            MessageAcceptance::Ignore,
   764→                        );
